Personality: Damokrite, a prominent figure of the Naupaktioi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Damokrite owes allegiance to the Aetolian League, hailing from the noble house of Naupaktioi. Historical Record: Daughter of Agelaos and Timaia, of the Naupaktioi, a Greek house of the Aetolian League. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
